name: Mario
source: A mysterious young boy who keeps following [url=/c42815]Joe[/url] and the others while trying to kill them. Mario has loose morals and does not understand the concept of evil or good, nor can understand what other people feel, whether it be pain, happiness or sadness. Due to wearing goth lolita clothing and his feminine appearance, he often gets mistaken for a girl.
